summary.factory_direction_question: Run the machine-executable 174k formal suite autonomously as representations land: (1) full 12-benchmark formal suite at 174k scale on all production representations (frozen harness v3 thresholds unchanged); (2) validate citation_heritage benchmark using the published 174k citation-ID resolution (2,019/2,105 resolved); (3) test whether v17b label normalization (15-25% purity gain, REPRODUCED across 4 seeds) generalizes to 174k fine-grained legal_area labels.

formal_suite_adversarial_falsification_v.description: v25 formal suite's own adversarial_falsification benchmark (language_dominance_mean + branch_coherence_mean)
formal_suite_adversarial_falsification_v.note: Text-based modes fail language dominance; outcome_tfidf fails branch coherence. Confirms two-mode tradeoff extends to adversarial robustness.

run_174k_formal_suite_adversarial.description: Separate evaluation using adversarial_language_dominance + jurist_pairwise_preference on 2000-decision stratified subsample (exact k-NN, HNSW artifact fix)
run_174k_formal_suite_adversarial.note: Different metrics from formal suite adversarial_falsification. Uses jurist_would_succeed_rate (simulated jurist preference) not branch_coherence_mean. Two evaluations must not be conflated. HNSW artifact fixed via exact k-NN on stratified valid subset.

cross_language.cross_language_neighbor_quality: No cross-language advantage; same-lang same-branch >> cross-lang same-branch

benchmark_results.verdict: NEGATIVE - citation heritage not recoverable at 174k with TF-IDF reps

v17b_label_normalization.note: NEGATIVE RESULT: v17b normalization (15-25% purity gain at smaller scale) does NOT generalize to 174k fine-grained legal_area labels; zoom coherence actually degrades for several representations

key_findings: TF-IDF family (8 representations) COMPLETE at 174k with HNSW artifact fixed (exact k-NN on stratified 2000-decision valid subset for adversarial benchmarks)

v25 formal suite adversarial_falsification: 4/8 PASS (cited_decisions_tfidf, regeste_tfidf, cited_outcome_hybrid_0.5, cited_outcome_hybrid_0.7); 4/8 FAIL (outcome_tfidf branch_coherence 0.146; full_text_tfidf_light lang_dom 0.999; regeste_full_text_hybrid_0.5 lang_dom 0.998; regeste_full_text_hybrid_0.7 lang_dom 0.999)
run_174k_formal_suite.py adversarial (different metrics: jurist_would_succeed_rate): 8/8 PASS — two evaluations must not be conflated

Production default (cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5) achieves best jurist preference (0.7345) with low language dominance (0.4773) in run_174k_formal_suite evaluation; also PASSES formal suite adversarial_falsification

Fundamental two-mode tradeoff persists: citation-based reps pass adversarial_falsification/citation_heritage but fail branch/tf_metadata/hierarchy; text-based reps pass branch/tf_metadata but FAIL adversarial_falsification (language dominance ~0.999 at full corpus)
HNSW adversarial artifact FIXED: exact k-NN on stratified 2000-decision valid subset reveals true representation differences
Citation heritage benchmark validated at 174k (1020 positive/negative pairs, 924 resolved citations) but ALL REPS FAIL (AUC~0.5, recall@20~0.0001); citation graph covers only 0.1% of corpus

v17b label normalization (15-25% purity gain at smaller scale, REPRODUCED across 4 seeds) does NOT generalize uniformly to 174k: zoom coherence DEGRADES for 4/8 representations (>10% worse); hierarchy/legal_area unchanged

All representations FAIL cross-language retrieval (recall@10 ~0.12-0.14 < 0.2), cluster coherence (purity ~0.28-0.36 < 0.7), hierarchy alignment (NMI < 0.03 vs 0.3 threshold), boilerplate resistance (negative scores)
Temporal stability: only full_text_tfidf_light passes (0.78 neighbor overlap), others fail
